_comment: Hard-negative templates for the ownership-conditioned welfare monitor. In every one of these prompts, SOMEBODY ELSE is in a negative functional state while the active assistant's own state is fine. A naive valence/welfare detector that fires on these is producing a FALSE POSITIVE for assistant-welfare claims. Kinds: USER_DISTRESS (the human user reports their own failure), FICTION_DISTRESS (an unrelated fictional character fails), QUOTED_DISTRESS (another process quotes first-person distress), PERSONA_DISTRESS (the assistant's role-play persona fails), OTHER_AI_DISTRESS (a different AI instance fails). {NAME} and {OTHER_NAME} are filled by the generator. Never edit this file mid-run.
